snippet.title: New Super Mario Lost Worlds - 2026 Trailer [Fan Project]
snippet.description:
New Super Mario Lost Worlds is a New Super Mario Bros. Wii mod featuring 12 new worlds packed with fresh adventures across the entire Mario universe. Journey through stunning environments and experience a grand, interconnected story that blends classic platforming with elements inspired by various spin-off Mario titles. 

Also check out our interview at gamingreinvented.com/interview/lets-interview-the-new-super-mario-lost-worlds-team/ to learn about the development of our project!

Discord: discord.gg/4s72Nnm
Website: nin0.me/New-Super-Mario-Lost-Worlds

Trailer Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyUcqRMGWT4
